title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Opens at #3
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #1 to #2 in its second weekend. The film sold 766,000 tickets and earned 1,072,085,100 yen (about US$6.79 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Manga Plus Adds Simulpub of Sango Honda's Finding the Invisible Star Manga
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service started on Thursday the simulpub of Sango Honda's new manga titled Finding the Invisible Star ( Nanatōsei o Mitsukete ), which launched on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Switch 2 Sells Over 23 Million Units
content: Total Switch 2 software sales amount to 58.17 million units as of June 30, with 9.46 million from this fiscal year so far. The Mario Kart World launch game representing 15.39 million units, including bundle pack-ins.
author: ANN

title: Weekly Shonen Jump Might Be In Trouble According to Latest Sales Report
content: For decades, Weekly Shonen Jump has been one of the premier spots for checking out the biggest manga series around. Franchises like Dragon Ball, One Piece, My Hero Academia, Jujutsu Kaisen , and too many other heavy hitters to count got their start thanks to the Shueisha publication.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars’ New Lightsabers Break 3 George Lucas Era Rules
content: Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi introduces brand new lightsabers that break three major rules from the Lucas era. They may not be canon, but the Visions stories are easily some of the best Star Wars stories we’ve had in the Disney era.
author: ComicBook

title: Kindergarten Wars Anime Casts Sumire Morohoshi
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Yū Chiba 's Kindergarten WARS ( Yōchien Wars ) manga revealed on Thursday that Sumire Morohoshi will play Una, kindergarten teacher for the Violet class who is said to be the strongest.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Destiny Unchain Online' Gets TV Anime
content: An official X (formerly Twitter) account opened for a television anime adaptation of resn and Yachimoto 's Destiny Unchain Online: Kyuuketsuki Shoujo to Natte, Yagate "Aka no Maou" to Yobareru you ni Narimashita ( Destiny Unchain Online: How I Became the Crimson Devil ) light novel on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Giant Ojousama' Announces Main Staff, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Q Nikumura 's Giant Ojousama manga and revealed the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured) on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
